risk: Distinct in-progress batch keys are not bounded by inbox capacity, so an unbounded or attacker-controlled key stream can retain increasing memory.

measuredEnvelope.limitation: The measurement is an empirical finite-source envelope and is not an implementation-enforced production bound.

controls: Callers must bound caller-controlled distinct in-progress batch-key cardinality.
The 0.10.x release documentation must state the observed 703-byte-per-key upper envelope and the tested range.
REV-15-L1 must be reopened before 0.11.0.0 or after the calendar expiry, whichever occurs first.
decisionSource: The release owner explicitly approved this stated scope, expiry, and controls in the implementation session on 2026-09-21.
